name: 99 Speed Mart Retail Holdings Berhad
overview: 根据所提供的公告，99 Speed Mart Retail Holdings Berhad 在 2026 年没有发布任何关于业务板块扩张、新增业务、缩减、出售或获得合约的公告。年内公告主要涉及季度业绩、股息除权、股东大会及董事会委员会成员变动。
overview_en: Based on the announcements provided, 99 Speed Mart Retail Holdings Berhad did not release any announcements in 2026 regarding business segment expansion, new businesses, downsizing, divestments, or contract wins. The year's announcements mainly covered quarterly results, dividend ex-dates, general meetings, and changes in board committee memberships.
